questions.question: A boat takes 40% less time to travel a certain distance in still water than to cover two times of the same distance downstream. If the speed of the boat in still water is 25 km/h, then what is the speed (in km/h) of the stream?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A boat takes 40% less time to travel a certain distance in still water than to cover two times of the same distance downstream.

**Concept used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

Downstream = u + v

Here, u = speed of the object

v = speed of the stream

The speed of the boat in still water is 25 km/h

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the stream be 'v' km/h

And let the distance covered be 'x' km

(x)/(25)=(60)/(100)times(2x)/(25+v)

⇒ (x)/(25)=(3)/(5)times(2x)/(25+v)

⇒ (x)/(25)=(6x)/(125+5v)

⇒ 125 + 5v = 150

⇒ 5v = 25

⇒ v = 5

So, speed of the stream = 5 km/h

**∴ The speed (in km/h) of the stream is 5.**

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 36 minutes and 45 minutes, respectively. Both these pipes were opened simultaneously. After 20 minutes, a leak at the bottom of the tank was spotted which was immediately sealed. The tank was full in another 15 minutes. The leak alone can empty the full tank in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 36 minutes and 45 minutes

**Concept used:**

Total work = Time taken by the pipes × efficiency of the pipes

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of the leakage be (- x) units/minute

LCM of 36 and 45 = 180

So, Let the total work be 180 units

Now, efficiency of pipe A = 180/36 = 5 units/minute

And, efficiency of pipe B = 180/45 = 4 units/minute

According to the question,

All three pipes were opened for the first 20 minutes, and then the leakage pipe was sealed and the tank was full in 15 minutes.

i.e., (9 - x) × 20 + 15 × 9 = 180

⇒ 180 - 20x + 135 = 180

⇒ - 20x = - 135

⇒ x = 135/20 or 27/4

Now, time taken by the leakage pipe to empty the tank = Total work\Efficiency

⇒ 180/(27/4) ⇒ 180 × (4/27)

⇒ 80/3

⇒ 26(2)/(3) minutes

**∴ The leak alone can empty the full tank in 26(2)/(3) minutes.**

questions.question: What will be the ratio of simple interest earned on a certain sum at the same rate percentage p.a. for 4 years and that for 6 years?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the Principal and Rate of interest are the same, Simple Interest is directly proportional to Time.

SI ∝ T

Ratio of SI = T₁ : T₂

Ratio of SI = 4 : 6

Ratio of SI = 2 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let the Principal = P

Let the Rate of Interest = R% p.a.

Time period 1 (T₁) = 4 years

Time period 2 (T₂) = 6 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8674fbbec7fbbd2e26589ad4751d52f51ea384728d02ce2c9f83fdeda364a6cb.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Simple Interest for 4 years (SI₁) = (P × R × 4) ÷ 100

⇒ Simple Interest for 6 years (SI₂) = (P × R × 6) ÷ 100

⇒ Ratio = SI₁ : SI₂

⇒ Ratio = [(P × R × 4) ÷ 100] : [(P × R × 6) ÷ 100]

⇒ Ratio = 4 : 6

⇒ Ratio = 2 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 2 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Concept

Simple Interest is calculated only on the initial principal sum. The interest earned every year remains constant. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Proportionality Rules in SI

When Principal and Rate are fixed, SI is directly proportional to Time. Similarly, when Principal and Time are fixed, SI is directly proportional to the Rate.

Sum Doubling Time

For a sum to double itself under simple interest, the accumulated interest must be equal to the principal amount. The required time can be found directly using T = 100 ÷ R.

Amount Calculation

The total accumulated amount at the end of the time period is the sum of the Principal and Simple Interest. Formula: A = P(1 + (R × T) ÷ 100).

questions.question: Concrete consists of 3 parts of lime, 7 parts of gravel and 6 parts of sand. Out of 800 kg of concrete, how much (in kg) is gravel?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Concrete consists of 3 parts of lime, 7 parts of gravel and 6 parts of sand.

**Calculation:**

Ratio of lime : gravel : sand = 3 : 7 : 6

Now,

In 800 kg of concrete,

Gravel = 800 × [7/(3 + 7 + 6)]

⇒ 800 × (7/16)

⇒ 350

So, required gravel = 350 kg

**∴ Gravel is 350 (in kg).**

questions.question: A shopkeeper allows a discount of 15% on the marked price of goods and still gains 70% on the whole. Find at what percentage above the cost price does he mark his goods.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

CP over MP = 100-D over 100+P

Where, D = discount%, P = profit%

According to the question,

CP over MP = 100-15 over 100+70

CP over MP = 85 over 170

CP over MP = 1 over 2

Thus, CP:MP = 1:2

The required ratio = (2-1)/1 × 100 = 100%

**Hence, the marked price should be marked at 100% above the cost price.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A shopkeeper allows a discount of 15% on the marked price of goods and still gains 70% on the whole. 

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of the goods be 100x

So, selling price = 100x + 100x × 70%

⇒ 170x

According to the question,

Marked price - marked price × 15% = 170x

⇒ 0.85Marked price = 170x

⇒ Marked price = 170x/0.85

⇒ Marked price = 200x

So, extra = 200x - 100x

⇒ 100x

Required % = (100x/100x) × 100

⇒ 100

**∴ He marks his goods at 100% above the cost price.**

questions.question: A man travelled from place A to B at 30 km/h and from B to C at 45 km/h. His average speed for the whole journey was 40 km/h. The ratio of the distance of AB : BC is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A man traveled from place A to B at 30 km/h and from B to C at 45 km/h. 

His average speed for the whole journey was 40 km/h. 

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance/ Total time

**Calculation:**

Let the distance between A and B (AB) be 'x' km and the distance between B and C (BC) be 'y' km.

Then, Total distance = (x + y) km

And, Total time = (x/30 + y/45) hrs

According to the question,

(x + y)/(x/30 + y/45) = 40

⇒ [(x + y)/{(6x + 4y)/180}] = 40

⇒ 180x + 180y = 40(6x + 4y)

⇒ 180x + 180y = 240x + 160y

⇒ 240x - 180x = 180y - 160y

⇒ 60x = 20y

⇒ x : y = 1 : 3

**∴ The required ratio is 1 : 3.**

questions.question: The surface area of a solid cube is 726 cm². It is melted and recast into a solid cylinder of radius 11 cm. What is the height (in cm) of the cylinder? (take pi=(22)/(7))
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The surface area of a solid cube is 726 cm2

The radius of the cylinder = 11 cm

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of cube = 6(side)²

Volume of cube = (side)³

**Calculation:**

6(side)² = 726

⇒ (Side)² = 726/6

⇒ (Side)2 = 121

⇒ Side = 11 cm

So, volume of the cube = (11)³ = 1331 cm³

Let the height of the cylinder be 'h' cm

According to the question,

π × 11² × h = 1331

⇒ (22)/(7) × 121× h = 1331

⇒ (22)/(7)h = 11

⇒ h = 11 × (7)/(22)

⇒ h = 3.5

**∴ The height (in cm) of the cylinder is 3.5.**

questions.question: If an 11-digit number 546789x531y is divisible by 88, then the value of (x - y) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

546789x531y is divisible by 88

**Concept used:**

1) If the last three digits of a number are divisible by 8, then the number is completely divisible by 8

2) If the difference of the sum of alternative digits of a number is 0 or divisible by 11, then that number is divisible by 11 completely.

3) If any number is completely divisible by 88 then the number is also completely divisible by 8 and 11

**Calculation:**

Given number is completely divisible by 88 then it is also divisible by 11 and 8

When the number is divisible by 8 then,

31y is divisible by 8 when y = 2 ----(1)

When the number is divisible by 11 then,

(5 + 6 + 8 + x + 3 + y) – (4 + 7 + 9 + 5 + 1)

⇒ 22 + x + y – 26

⇒ x + y – 4 

⇒ x + 2 – 4 ----(From eq (1))

⇒ x – 2

Now,

For x = 2,

x – 2 = 0

So, x = 2

Now,

(x - y) ⇒ 2 - 2

⇒ 0 

**∴ The required answer is 0.**

questions.question: A man borrowed ₹50,000 for 2 years at a rate of 2% on compound interest. The difference in the amount at the end of the first year and that at the end of the second year is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principle = Rs. 50,000

Time = 2 years

Rate = 2%

**Concept Used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ,

Where,

A is amount,

P is principle,

R is rate of interest

n is number of years

**Calculation:**

Using the formula, 

For 1st year,

⇒ A = 50,000(1 + 2/100) = 50,000 × 102/100 = 51,000

For 2nd year,

⇒ A = 50,000(1 + 2/100)² = 50,000(51/50)²

⇒ A = 50,000 × 51/50 × 51/50 = 52,020

Difference = 52020 - 51000 = 1020

**∴ Difference in the amount is Rs. 1,020.**

questions.question: Mr. Ram gave 60% of the money he had to his wife. He also gave equal amounts to his three children, that is, each one got 20% of the remaining amount after giving to his wife. Three-fifths of the amount now left was spent on miscellaneous items and the remaining amount of ₹9,600 was deposited in the bank. How much money (in ₹) did Mr. Ram gave to his wife?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ram gave 60% of the money to his wife

Gave 20% of the remaining money to each one of his 3 children

Spent 3/5 of left money 

Remaining amount is Rs. 9,600

**Calculation:**

Let the total amount be Rs. 10,000

Money gave to his wife,

60% of 10,000 = 60/100 × 10,000 = 6,000

Remaining = 10,000 - 6,000 = 4,000

20% of 4,000 to each children, 

⇒ 20/100 × 4,000 = 800

Total amount to children = 3 × 800 = 2,400 (because he has 3 children) 

Remaining amount = 4,000 - 2,400 = 1,600

Spent 3/5 of 1,600 = 3/5 × 1,600 = 960

Remaining amount = 1,600 - 960 = 640

According to the question, 

⇒ 640 = 9,600

⇒ 1 = 9,600/640 = 15

Money gave to Wife = 6,000 × 15 = 90,000

**∴ The money Ram gave to his wife is Rs. 90,000**

questions.question: If the difference between 40% of a number and 30% of the same number is 70, then the number is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Let the number be N

N × 40% - N × 30% =70

N × 10% = 70 

N × 1/10 = 70

N = 70 × 10

N = 700

**Hence, the correct answer is 700.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The difference between 40% of a number and 30% of the same number is 70

**Calculation:**

Let the number be 100x

Then 40% of 100x = 100x × (40/100)

⇒ 40x

30% of 100x = 100x × (30/100)

⇒ 30x

Difference = 40x - 30x = 10x

Here, 10x = 70

⇒ x = 7

So, 100x = 100 × 7

⇒ 700

So, the number is 700

**∴ The required answer is 700.**

questions.question: The cost price of an article is ₹2,250, which is 25% below the marked price. If the article is sold at a 15% discount, what profit percent is made on the transaction?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let the marked price be Rs. 100a

Then, Cost price = 100a × 75%

Cost price = 75a

CP over MP = 100 - d\% over 100+p\%

75a over 100a = 100-15 over 100+p\%

3 over 4 = 85 over 100+p\%

100+p% = 340/3

p% = 340/3 - 100

p% = 40/3 

p% = 13.33

∴ The profit is 13.33%

**Hence, the correct answer is 13.33%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The cost price of an article is ₹2,250, which is 25% below the marked price. If t

The article is sold at a 15% discount

**Concept used:**

Selling price = Marked price (100 - Discount)%

Profit% = (Profit/Cost price) × 100

**Calculation:**

Marked price - Marked price × 25% = 2250

⇒ 0.75Marked price = 2250

⇒ Marked price = 2250/0.75

⇒ Marked price = 3000

So, selling price = 3000 - 3000 × 15%

⇒ 3000 - 450

⇒ 2550

Profit = 2550 - 2250

⇒ 300

Profit % = (300/2250) × 100

⇒ 13.33%

**∴ 13.33% profit is made on the transaction.**
